skill.name: orova-seo-check
skill.description: Website SEO check and backlink lookup using the public Orova SEO Check API: 90+ technical, content, speed and link checks in 12 groups, PageSpeed results, referring domains from the Common Crawl domain graph, and a shareable report link on orova.vn. No API key, no signup. Triggers on: SEO check, SEO audit, technical SEO, backlinks, who links to, referring domains, site health.
skill.summary: Retrieve website SEO scores, prioritized check results, and domain-level backlink data through the public Orova API.
skill.author: nguyendotrongan-netizen

security_audit.summary: All 52 static findings are false positives involving documented API requests, display strings, identifiers, and the standard skill installation path. No evidence found of malicious instructions, shell injection, local credential collection, or concealed execution. A separate privacy risk exists because complete URLs, including embedded credentials or tokens, are submitted without filtering.

remediation.issue: Complete submitted URLs can contain credentials, access tokens, or private fragments.
remediation.suggestion: Reject URL user information, remove fragments, and warn before transmitting query parameters that may contain secrets. Document third-party submission clearly.

content.user_title: Audit Website SEO and Find Referring Domains
content.value_statement: Website owners need clear evidence of SEO issues and backlink coverage. This skill retrieves Orova scan results and presents grouped checks with domain-level backlink data.
actual_capabilities: Submit a website URL to the public Orova API and poll for scan completion.
Present scores across 12 groups, including metadata, crawlability, security headers, content, speed, and links.
Separate failed checks, warnings, passed counts, and skipped checks in a Markdown report.
Retrieve Common Crawl referring domains and domain ranks, with backlink lookup limits from 1 to 100 rows.
Provide English or Vietnamese shareable report links and optional raw API output.
Report API errors, rate limits, cached results, scan failures, and timeouts.
limitations: Requires Python 3.9 or later, network access, and an available Orova API; submitted URLs leave your machine.
Scans cover the homepage and a few sample pages, not every page or authenticated content.
Common Crawl data is domain-level and can miss small or new sites; zero results do not prove no backlinks.
Documented guest limits are five scans and 30 backlink lookups per hour per IP; same-domain scans may use 24-hour cached results.

use_cases.description: Get a grouped SEO report and plain-language explanations of failed checks before assigning website improvements.

use_cases.title: Investigate Technical SEO Issues
use_cases.description: Review server headers, metadata, sitemap checks, and available speed results to prioritize technical corrections.

use_cases.title: Inspect Backlink Coverage
use_cases.description: Retrieve referring domains and domain ranks for a public domain while accounting for Common Crawl coverage limits.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Public Website
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the SEO of [public website URL]. Summarize the overall score, failed checks, warnings, and shareable report link.

prompt_templates.title: Find Referring Domains
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up backlinks for [public domain] with a limit of 50 rows. Show referring domains, domain ranks, and data coverage limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Technical Fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [public website URL]. Group failed checks by implementation effort and explain why each matters. Distinguish skipped checks from failures.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Detailed Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve raw scan results for [public website URL] with a 240-second timeout. Compare all 12 group scores, flag unavailable metrics, and prioritize fixes.

The full report includes group scores and a shareable link when a scan identifier is available.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: explain a backlink lookup that returns no referring domains.
output: No referring domains were found in the Common Crawl graph.
This result does not prove that the site has no backlinks.
The data is domain-level and may omit small or new sites.

best_practices: Use public URLs without credentials, access tokens, or private query parameters before submitting them to Orova.
Prioritize failed checks before warnings, and preserve unavailable or skipped statuses without inventing measurements.
Check cache notices and rate limits before repeating scans; interpret backlink results within Common Crawl coverage.
anti_patterns: Submitting signed links, credential-bearing URLs, or confidential staging addresses to the public service.
Treating a sample-page scan as a complete site crawl or a comprehensive security assessment.
Claiming that zero referring domains proves no backlinks, or that unavailable metrics have passed.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: The skill uses the public guest API without an API key or signup.

faq.question: Where does the scan run?
faq.answer: The scan runs on Orova servers. The client sends your supplied URL and locale, or your domain and requested backlink limit.

faq.question: What are the local requirements?
faq.answer: You need Python 3.9 or later and network access. The bundled client uses only the Python standard library.

faq.question: Does it scan the entire website?
faq.answer: No. The documented scan covers the homepage and a few sample pages, rather than every page.

faq.question: How complete are the backlink results?
faq.answer: Results come from the Common Crawl domain graph, not a page-level index. Small or new sites may have missing data.

faq.question: What happens when I repeat a scan?
faq.answer: The documentation states that same-domain scans within 24 hours return cached results without using another scan. Guest rate limits also apply.
